entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at forearm height, 100mm look, razor-thin depth of field, the lens level with the drake's eye.
entries.subject: A leather-gloved forearm held out like a falconer's, cropped at the elbow, with a young drake gripping it: a cat-sized dragon with deep emerald scales, folded translucent wings, a crest of small horns and a thin curl of smoke rising from its nostrils. A faint ember glow shows between the scales along its throat, and a thin thread of shared light runs from the glove to its chest. Its golden eye is the sharpest point of the frame. Behind, a blurred misty pine forest at dawn with drifting sparks.
entries.accent: deep emerald scales with molten orange ember glow

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder medium shot at chest height, 35mm, the ranger's hooded shoulder softly blurred in the foreground edge of the frame.
entries.subject: A hooded ranger seen from behind, face turned away, one gloved hand resting on the shoulder of an enormous shaggy bear that stands calmly beside them in a forest clearing, head lowered, its fur dusted with drifting autumn leaves and floating motes of amber light, as if the beast were drawn out of the forest itself. The bear looks quietly out at the trees. Tall trunks and low golden sun rays fill the background.
entries.accent: warm russet-brown and amber autumn light

entries.camera: Extreme wide shot at eye level, 16mm look, the figure tiny in the lower third of the frame, enormous empty depth.
entries.subject: On a vast pale salt flat at dusk a tiny figure, seen from behind, walks toward a tall oval doorway of pure light standing in the open air, its edge crackling with planar energy. Through the doorway a different world is visible: floating islands under a glowing sky. The figure's long shadow stretches back toward the camera, and more thin vertical rifts of light shimmer along the horizon, as if the whole plain were full of doors.
entries.accent: electric cyan portal light under a deep indigo sky

entries.camera: First-person point of view over a drawn bow, 24mm look, the arrow shaft running from the lens into the distance, deep focus on the far target.
entries.subject: Looking along a drawn arrow from behind the bow: a leather-gloved hand cropped at the wrist holds the string at full draw, the fletching close to the lens and the arrowhead pin-sharp in the centre. At the far end of a long misty valley, a perfect glowing ring, a hunter's mark, floats around a lone standing stone on a distant ridge. Pines and a dark river lie between, under pale dawn mist.
entries.accent: cold dawn grey-blue mist with one vermilion glowing mark

entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) low shot from knee height inside a lightless cavern, wide lens, the horizon tilted about twenty degrees.
entries.subject: A hooded ranger seen from behind, standing just beyond the edge of a small pool of lantern light and so deep in darkness that only a thin cold rim of light on one shoulder and the tip of a bow reveal the shape. The lantern light on the floor stops short of the figure, as if refusing to touch it. Ahead, the cavern opens into a long tunnel of dripping stalactites lit by pale glowing fungus.
entries.accent: near-black shadow with pale phosphor-green fungus glow

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, symmetrical, 28mm look, the churned mud filling the whole frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at black churned mud holding one enormous three-clawed monster footprint as wide as a cartwheel, filled with still, moonlit water. A gloved hand cropped at the wrist lays a silver-tipped arrow across the print for scale. Above the water floats a ring of abstract glowing glyph shapes, non-legible, tracing pale lines of light across the print like a map of weak points. Snapped twigs and torn bark lead off toward the dark edge of the frame.
entries.accent: cold silver moonlight, steel grey and bone white

entries.camera: Ground-level low angle looking up through fern fronds and glowing toadstools, 28mm, the foreground softly blurred.
entries.subject: A hooded figure seen from behind, mid-step at the centre of a fairy ring of softly glowing toadstools in a moonlit glade. Half of the figure is already dissolving into a swirl of lilac mist and silver motes, while a pale translucent afterimage of the same figure stands several steps away at the edge of the glade, trailing petals. Fireflies and butterflies drift between the ferns under a huge pale moon.
entries.accent: twilight rose-pink and lilac with drifting firefly gold

entries.camera: Silhouette shot against a low rising sun, 135mm telephoto compression, the sun a bright disc behind the swarm.
entries.subject: A lone silhouette stands in a wildflower meadow at sunrise, arms loosely open, the body from the shoulders down breaking up into a vast spiralling swarm of tiny winged shapes: butterflies, bees, dragonflies and small birds, each one distinct, pouring across the frame in a long arc while the outline of the figure is still readable inside the cloud of wings. Pollen and petals glitter in the backlight.

entries.camera: Side-on close-up still life at snow level, 85mm, very shallow depth of field, the bow running across the frame in sharp focus.
entries.subject: A longbow lies across a fresh snow bank, its limbs and string furred with thick hoarfrost, and beside it a single arrow with a tip of glowing blue ice stands upright in the snow. Around the arrow orbits a ring of floating frost shards and snow crystals, with a luminous ring hovering above the tip like a hunter's mark. In the soft blur behind, a snowbound pine forest at dusk, and a faint, tall, faceless figure made of drifting snow among the trees.
entries.accent: glacial white and icy sapphire blue

entries.camera: High-angle three-quarter view from above and behind, 28mm, looking down a woodland path, the long shadow filling the lower frame.
entries.subject: A small hooded figure seen from behind and above, standing on a rotting forest path. Its own shadow, thrown by a low sickly light, has grown into a towering shape that stretches across the path and up the twisted trees, crowned with branching antler-like thorns and jagged fang-like spikes, writhing like smoke. Grey fungus, withered flowers and pale mist line the path, and thin rust-red mist threads through the roots.
entries.accent: bruise-plum and rotting umber with sickly lichen-yellow glow
